title: How a Godly Man Wins the War His Phone Starts Every Morning
caption:
This generation's battle didn't exist for your grandfather. He never had a device in his pocket built to be the first and last thing he touches every day. You do, and it needs a daily fight, not a 30-day detox.

Put it in another room before you've touched it once. Open the Word before the app with the red dot, because whoever gets your attention first shapes the rest of your day. When the thumb reaches for it, name what you're actually avoiding. Then tell a brother the real number, not the vague version.

If you can't put it down, something other than Christ is holding it for you.

#faith #phoneaddiction #discipline #godlyman #christianmen
